title: Localization, Local--Global Transfer, and Hull Theory for $C4^{\ast}$-Modules over Commutative Rings
summary: Let \(R\) be a commutative ring and \(M\) an \(R\)-module. We develop a localization and local-global theory for \(C4\)-modules, \(C4^{\ast}\)-modules, strongly \(C4^{\ast}\)-modules, \(C4\)-hulls, and pseudo-continuous hulls over commutative rings. The problem is structural: these notions are defined through decompositions, summand conditions, and minimal extensions, while localization changes decomposition data, support, and hull minimality. We prove forward localization theorems for the \(C4\), \(C4^{\ast}\), and strongly \(C4^{\ast}\) conditions under exact lifting hypotheses formulated…
